title: The AI helper's 'leave your number' box also takes anyone's mobile number without checking it
what: After a chat with the AI helper on a gym's web page, the visitor can leave a name and mobile number so the gym calls back. The number is never checked as belonging to the visitor, and it replaces the name and number on that chat's enquiry. Anyone can type a stranger's number, and the gym then calls or messages a person who never asked. This is the same gap as the 'Ask the gym' form, but in a second place, so fixing only that form leaves this one open. Not live today: the helper is behind switches that are off.
expected: A number left from the AI chat is kept only after the visitor proves it (the WhatsApp check Join online uses), or is clearly marked 'number not checked' for the gym.
who: gym owners and strangers whose number is typed
how_often: whenever someone types another person's number
fix_line: Use the same number check as the Ask the gym fix for the chat's call-back box
